wikipedia.notes: A 14-year-old middle school student opened fire with a hunting rifle at a school in Aubagne, France wounding two people. The shooting is being investigated as an act of terrorism involving the True Crime Community.

A 13-year-old student stabbed a teacher and a fellow student. After the incident was investigated, his TikTok profile was found to contain content related to the Great Replacement Theory. He had also been inspired by Timofey Kulyamov and Brenton Tarrant.
Two gunmen committed a mass shooting against a Christian Orthodox Church in Hammoud, Karak governorate, Jordan. The attack occurred during a funeral. The two attackers fled the scene.
A gunmen drove his car across Trappes and La Verrière, France, committing multiple shootings. The attacker targeted immigrants at a petrol station, a medical centre and a playground.

A gunmen drove shot three people inside his home, he then drove his car through the Main Market Square of Krakow, where he shot bystanders. The attacker was stopped and wounded by the police. Polish authorities called the shooting an act of terrorism, possibly inspired by far-right ideologies.
